mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_submission (room_id, user_id, character_answer, time_answer, location_answer, action_answer, explanation, submit_time, score, score_detail, submission_order) VALUES (#{roomId}, #{userId}, #{characterAnswer}, #{timeAnswer}, #{locationAnswer}, #{actionAnswer}, #{explanation}, #{submitTime}, #{score}, #{scoreDetail}, #{submissionOrder})
mapper.update: UPDATE game_submission SET character_answer = #{characterAnswer}, time_answer = #{timeAnswer}, location_answer = #{locationAnswer}, action_answer = #{actionAnswer}, explanation = #{explanation}, submit_time = #{submitTime}, score = #{score}, score_detail = #{scoreDetail}, submission_order = #{submissionOrder} WHERE id = #{id}
